desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT/defence community is focused on the Trump White House shake-up (Susie Wiles stepping down), Russian threats to Ukrainian energy infrastructure and bridges, and heightened aerial activity/explosions in the Middle East. The single most important thread is the confirmed transition at the top of the U.S. administration and its immediate ripple effects.

## MAIN THREADS
### Trump White House Chief of Staff Change
- [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2118785003584725136) and [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2118780734638878761) both report President Trump announcing Susie Wiles will step aside November 9 for Stephen Miller; [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2118783648665075883) adds CBS reporting she resigned Thursday night.
- [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2118779678982820135) notes in Hebrew that Wiles is the first to pay the price for election defeat.

### Russian Threats to Ukrainian Infrastructure
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2118780329792073996) cites FT sources that Putin threatens continued strikes on bridges, ports and power plants until Kyiv accepts Moscow’s terms, with slim ceasefire prospects at Abu Dhabi talks.
- [@NOELreports](https://x.com/NOELreports/status/2118784147955290350) reports Zelensky warning of imminent Russian strikes on energy sites and Dnipro bridges, urging faster Patriot deliveries.

### Middle East Aerial Activity
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2118782922471645527) and [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2118780186749464732) track warplanes over southern Iraq and 8 USAF tankers over UAE/Saudi/Strait of Hormuz/Persian Gulf.
- [@hey_itsmyturn](https://x.com/hey_itsmyturn/status/2118779749833097715) notes a sound explosion reported from the Strait of Hormuz area.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2118784531398262827) posts a Flightradar24 image (unconfirmed context).  
- [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2118785003584725136) flags a fake Arabic Axios account claiming a Qatar PM statement on U.S.-Iran talks.

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts will watch for follow-through on U.S. personnel moves, any confirmed strikes on Ukrainian energy targets, and whether Middle East tanker/explosion activity signals escalation or routine repositioning ahead of potential diplomacy.
